why: No major reviewer or authority tests sub-10 lb stations for 100W USB-C laptop charging: TechRadar's two entries are a news post on a 99Wh palm unit and a review of a 2kWh station. The only page that answers the exact question (treksavvy) is a spec comparison that disclaims testing; the rest are affiliate listicles answering neighbouring questions (camping, indoor backup, college) and four results have no text. A focused page comparing the Elite 30 V2, SOLIX C300 AC, RIVER 3 and Explorer 300 on weight, USB-C wattage, measured laptop charges and current prices would stand out.
